      public void addWheel(String type, int pos)
      Add a wheel to this slot machine, place the roulette wheel on the left or right side, specify its type, and change its color.
      Parameters:
      type - type is the specific kind of wheel to add (e.g., "rebel").

      color - color is the color of the wheel.
